topics.label: Course introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: It introduces the lecture series, the student cohort, and the core learning outcomes for the session.

topics.label: Biological concepts and experimental models of cancer development
topics.groupedBecause: They define cancer as a failure of cellular differentiation and genetic regulation while addressing the challenges of modelling complex tissue architecture in culture.

topics.label: Tumour invasion, metastasis, and the benign-to-malignant spectrum
topics.groupedBecause: They characterise how tumours progress from benign lesions to invasive and metastatic malignancies using histological and clinical examples.

topics.label: Tumour nomenclature conventions and exceptions
topics.groupedBecause: It outlines the standard naming conventions and key exceptions for benign and malignant neoplasms based on their tissue of origin.

topics.label: Pathophysiological mechanisms of cancer morbidity and mortality
topics.groupedBecause: It details how local tissue disruption and widespread metastatic colonization cause severe illness and patient death.

topics.label: Patterns of tumour incidence in humans and comparative species
topics.groupedBecause: They examine the comparative frequency and tissue distribution of tumours across humans and other multicellular organisms.

topics.label: Principles, methods, and limitations of cancer screening
topics.groupedBecause: They evaluate the clinical rationale, histological indicators, and practical challenges of population screening across various cancer types.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and practical reminders
topics.groupedBecause: It concludes the lecture with a review of learning objectives and reminders for upcoming practical sessions.
